title: XP summaries page v2
description: Body of GET /api/xp?view=paged: one keyset page of xp-summary, ascending by bindingId, at most 200 per page, for the bot bindings that have at least one XP entry (the same membership as xp-summaries v1, which GET /api/xp without view still returns, capped at 500). nextCursor is an opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page; a client that wants every bot reads pages until it is null. A bot with no entry is absent and reads as 0 XP at level 1. Pages are read one after another, so a bot that gains its first XP between two reads shows on the page its id sorts into, which can be one already read; the poller repeats the whole walk. asOfMs is the server time the page was read.
